_about: CRL metadata-annotation registry — the canonical tag vocabulary, value shapes, cardinality, and lifecycle for `@tag` annotations carried on `- meta is `@tag: <body>`.` lines. Consumed by the (future) Validator; human companion is metadata-model.md in this folder.
statusNote: Two design-review rounds complete; vocabulary settled. The Validator that enforces these rules is not yet implemented (see README — validateCRL is a placeholder). Ref schemes (kg:/reef:) are illustrative.

carrier.terminator: the `.` goes AFTER the closing backtick: - meta is `...`.
carrier.scopeNote: The `meta` carrier exists only on `concept` (metaLine* in conceptBody). Metadata on decision/activity/terminology is out of scope for v1.
carrier.backCompat: A meta line with no leading @tag is a legitimate untyped note and passes validation.

families.A-external-ref: Scored hints to an external store. Candidates are extraction-derived (replace-by-run); confirmed are durable.

ExternalReference.note: Shared shape for the two external-ref tags. KG (Concept Graph) and REEF are DISTINCT stores serving different purposes; both hold scored hints.
ExternalReference.rendering: <display label>; ref <ref>; confidence <0..1>; rank <int>; status <enum>; by <author>

system.source: derived from the tag (@kg-concept -> kg [the Concept Graph, hint for the decision], @reef-reference -> reef [the great REEF, a hint])

ref.note: identifier within the Concept Graph (kg) or REEF (reef)

rank.note: 1-based; 1 = best-ranked candidate. Explicit; NOT inferred from line order.

Origin.rendering: trailing `; by <author>; run <id>; at <iso-timestamp>; source <ref>#<hash>; span <range>; quote <text>`

by.note: omitted = implicit current author of the edit

span.note: source span/range — more actionable than a whole-doc hash

tags.notes: Stable concept identifier. Durable metadata should key on @id so a concept rename does not orphan its tags. Rename/split/merge handling is a known v1 gap.
Author's gloss of the object. Distinct from `evidence` (verbatim source quote).

Semantic parse of the SOURCE narrative (meaning representation). Extraction exhaust.

validatorRules: value-shape mismatch (e.g. @kg-concept missing ref; confidence outside [0,1]; rank < 1) -> error
cardinality violation (e.g. two @description on one concept) -> error
malformed-tag lint: a meta line starting '@' but not matching ^@[a-z][a-z0-9-]*: -> warning (probable malformed tag — catches silent demotion to an untyped note)
a meta line NOT starting '@' -> legitimate untyped note (back-compat), no diagnostic
re-run staleness: warn if two distinct run ids' family-C / candidate-ref exhaust coexist on one concept
family-C tags and candidate (status=candidate) external refs MUST carry `run` -> error if omitted (otherwise the re-run replace match key is undefined)
reRunReplaceRule: On re-extraction, the producer replaces the prior run's family-C tags (semantic-parse-text) and candidate (status=candidate) external refs for a concept, matched by by/run. Confirmed refs and family-B durable tags (id, description, ke-feedback, logic-expression-text, controlled-natural-language, crl-future-expression, business-logic-deferred, clinical-logic-deferred) are never auto-replaced. Refs with status=rejected or status=superseded are durable historical records (preserved across re-runs so negative review work isn't lost).
